007/**

020@HistoryLogProps(
021    opCode = 283,
022    displayName = "WUMP Occlusion Debug",
023    internalName = "LID_WUMP_OCCLUSION_DEBUG"
024)
025public class WumpOcclusionDebugHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
026
027
028    public WumpOcclusionDebugHistoryLog() {}
029    public WumpOcclusionDebugHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
030        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
031        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
032
033    }
034
035    public int typeId() {
036        return 283;
037    }
038
039    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
040        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
041        this.cargo = raw;
042        parseBase(raw);
043
044    }
045
046    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
047        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
048            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(283, 0), // 283 = 256 + 27
049            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
050            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum)));
051    }
052
053}
